title: Onboarding checklist for PMS and AIF
objectives: Run the seven-point PMS/AIF onboarding checklist.
Say what must be shared and explained before investing.
body_md:
Onboarding checklist for PMS and AIF: core mutual fund portfolio and emergency fund already in place. Suitability documented, including lock-in tolerance. Disclosure Document (PMS) or PPM (AIF) shared and key risks explained. Full fee structure shown in rupees, including profit share or carry. Tax treatment explained; client advised to consult their CA. Commission disclosed; direct option mentioned. For AIFs: drawdown schedule and expected tenure explained.

> **Investor takeaway:** Compare costs, lock-in and tax side by side before choosing PMS or AIF over a mutual fund.
example: Before a ₹1 crore AIF commitment: core in place, lock-in tolerance documented, PPM shared, fees in rupees, tax via CA, commission disclosed, drawdown schedule explained.
say: Share the Disclosure Document or PPM and explain key risks.
never: Treat the minimum ticket as proof of suitability.

check.q: Which document must be shared for a PMS?
o: The Disclosure Document, with key risks explained
check.why: Disclosure Document (PMS) or PPM (AIF) shared and key risks explained.

check.q: For AIFs, the checklist additionally requires explaining:
o: The drawdown schedule and expected tenure
check.why: For AIFs: drawdown schedule and expected tenure explained.

check.q: Before adding PMS or AIF, the client must already have:
o: A diversified mutual fund core and an emergency fund
check.why: Core mutual fund portfolio and emergency fund already in place.
